label: sharingan0419g-afk.github.io/cuentafreefire

reasons: Page title and visible copy ('Roblox - Cargando...', 'Verificando cuenta...') impersonate Roblox to trick visitors into thinking a login/verification is happening.

Source function _getRobloxToken() steals the .ROBLOSECURITY cookie, _getAllCookies() grabs all cookies, and _stealSavedCredentials() uses a hidden autocomplete form to steal saved browser usernames/passwords.

The exfil payload (token, cookies, saved credentials, IP, user agent) is POSTed to the Discord webhook 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1538363000019492864/UhzsSnl-8lM1FZrJZ92IStmVEmcKTr-ec04X7CO_F845s1qluXfK-wIQrartqtsWvyEx' before redirecting to the real Roblox site.
